notes.title: Steam Remote Play Together Week
notes.notes:
For Steam's Remote Play Together week, we've got CPR marked down 25%!
Come join in the fun in the split-screen local multiplayer or via the internet or steam deck with remote play together action.

To kick it off, we did a quick "devs play" stream with our team playing on steam deck and PC:
[previewyoutube=xxmzi4mAj_8;full][/previewyoutube]  

Post your favorite screenshots from your races, and the one with the most "thumbs up" will get a special badge for their ship!

notes.title: Cygnus_Pizza_Race-0.9.0.15
notes.notes:
Fixing bugs, moving to UE 4.27 for long term support.
Sorry for the mammoth patch, UE 4.27 changed compression libraries, making the new datafile quite different.

Hopefully you'll enjoy the new holiday fun, and there shouldn't be any large updates for quite some time.

notes.title: Welcome to Track 20!
notes.notes:
The final track is out and ready for all! 
Still chasing down some minor issues with track 20, but hopefully we'll be able to get those resolved.
For now, enjoy exploring the new track, and once you've beaten track 20, you'll have unlocked the Champion ship to use on all tracks! 

From this update, there'll be no further substantial updates, though there may be some additional bugfixes if we can get to the bottom of the issues with track 20.

notes.title: Cygnus Pizza Race 0.9.0.13
notes.notes:
[h1]Finals time![/h1]
Time for the Final Race of the tournament of Champions, so here's the first sighting of track 20!
The next patch will include the new champion ship will be unlockable for everyone who has beaten track 20.
Good luck racers!

notes.title: June Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39471311/161b9118fabc97407c33c522747ff14217cf35f8.png[/img]

Cygnus_Pizza_Race-0.9.0.7a
[h2]Welcome to the June track! There's more than one route to victory on this month's track.[/h2]

This is also our first Linux release! Please report any bugs promptly on the [url=https://forum.longplay.games/c/game-feedback/11]forum.[/url]
Please consider this Linux release to be a bit of a "beta" stage, while we continue to work out known issues with [b]AMD[/b] cards.
We are working to resolve these, but we have spent quite a lot of time trying to track them down, and we felt it best to get this game in your hands sooner rather than later.

Enjoy the track!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39471311/ce9ee518f691b08601ade99c4abbed89a7d900f0.png[/img]

notes.title: March Track Release
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome, Master Chef of Alien Scumbags![/b]
This patch brings in a little cross-promo with Alien Scumbags, and brings Master Chef's ship to join the spectators on some tracks.
March's track 12 is now here and ready for people to check out and enjoy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39471311/7630f1b936e8aefd2c4db8cbbe65450140ba7cbe.png[/img]

[b]You can check out Alien Scumbags here: [/b]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1252410/Alien_Scumbags/

And you'll see why Master Chef needed a little R&R after fighting off wave after wave of enemies in this great little pixel art shooter by Monster Finger Games.

Keep an eye out for Master Chef's ship as you race around, and we hope you have a blast with the March track!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39471311/87bbd17d895df081558131506a8ecc81d1f967f1.png[/img]

notes.title: Cygnus Pizza Race Season 2: Out Now

[h1]Today is the debut of Season 2, come join in the fun!
[/h1]
Rev up those pepperoni powered pizza pods racers, we have a whole season of great tracks coming, 10 in all.
